globalLayer.description: Elements present for the whole journey, independent of scroll position.

elements.behaviour: 3px bar fixed to the top of the viewport; fills left to right with scroll position (blue → mint gradient).

parts.behaviour: White bar; slides up out of view once scrollY > 24px (.nav.scrolled).
Stays pinned to the top at all times; background darkens on scroll.

elements.linkBehaviour: Section links smooth-scroll (Lenis, 1.4s ease-out) so the section heading lands just below the link bar (components/SmoothScroll.tsx → useSectionLinks).

elements.visibility: Hidden on load. Slides up once the hero card's bottom is above 25% of the viewport; hides again when the closing section's top reaches 85% of the viewport.

elements.behaviour: Lenis smooth scrolling drives GSAP ScrollTrigger. Scroll is locked while any overlay is open (gsc:lock event).

accessibility.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion disables Lenis, reveals, fan-out, floating chips drift, marquee, rotating word, flicker and hover sweeps; content renders in place.
accessibility.keyboard: Esc closes any open overlay. FAQ uses native <details>/<summary>.

flow.heading: Create your account
rules: An email already tied to a different phone is rejected (409)
Max 5 OTP requests per phone per hour, 20 per IP per hour
Session cookie gsc_session: httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 30 days
flow.note: SMS provider is a mock today (lib/server/sms.ts); in non-production the OTP is echoed on screen as 'Test mode'.

flow.resume: Prefills from the server draft (or a local draft keyed by phone) and opens at the first step with an unanswered question. Submitted applications open read-only.
chrome: Progress: Step n of 7, % complete, clickable step pills up to the furthest step reached
navigation: Save and continue → (validates the current step first)
Save and exit (saves, closes the panel)

autosave.trigger: 1.2s after typing stops, and on every step change
autosave.fallback: localStorage (gsc-application-draft-v2:{phone}) if the server save fails

flow.sessionExpiry: A 401 on save or submit returns the user to the account gate with a message; answers stay on the device.

flow.validation: Jumps to the first step with an invalid field and shows the browser's message.
flow.success: Form locks read-only; status: 'Your application has been submitted. We will be in touch by email.'

reviewNotes: Registration only works on a server build; the GitHub Pages build shows a 'Registration opens soon' panel.
SMS OTP uses a mock provider; a real provider (Twilio Verify, MSG91…) must be wired before launch.

npm audit flags Next.js 14.2.35 (critical) and its bundled PostCSS (high). Server-side advisories do not affect the static build but apply once the registration backend is hosted; the fix is a major upgrade to Next.js 16, to be done on its own branch.
No analytics or event tracking is instrumented yet; the ctaInventory above is the suggested event list.
